title: Claude Code hooks announce a session's work through coord.py and show overlapping sessions, leaving the choice to the operator
goal: A SessionStart hook, .claude/hooks/coord_hook.py, posts the session's intent through coord.py (fields session and item: the item of its work/<id> branch and its claimed items) with a presence lease session/<session id>, then adds coord.py digest output for keys overlapping this session's items in at most 10 lines, naming each other session and its claim and telling Claude to ask the operator whether to wait, join or proceed, in Claude's context and the operator's terminal; the same hook shows overlaps at a backlog.py claim (PreToolUse on Bash) and at a /kb-research start (PreToolUse on Skill); a SessionEnd hook releases the session's leases; the hooks call only coord.py commands, so the protocol stays vendor-neutral and hooks are one client of it; no hook exits 2 on an overlap; a hook prints nothing when no other session overlaps

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
T,H=os.path.abspath("_tools/coord.py"),os.path.abspath(".claude/hooks/coord_hook.py")
if not (os.path.isfile(T) and os.path.isfile(H)):print("coord.py or coord_hook.py missing: the work adds the hook");sys.exit(1)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"coord.sqlite"))
def c(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=60)
def repo(n,b):
    r=os.path.join(d,n);s.run(["git","init","-q","-b",b,r],check=True);s.run(["git","-C",r,"-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","i"],check=True);return r
def hook(ev,sid,cwd,**x):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,H],input=json.dumps(dict(hook_event_name=ev,session_id=sid,cwd=cwd,**x)),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,cwd=cwd,timeout=60);return p.returncode,p.stdout
for i in range(15):c("post","--kind","intent","--field","session=other-%d"%i,"--field","item=ST-aaaaaaaa")
a,b=repo("a","work/ST-aaaaaaaa"),repo("b","work/ST-zzzzzzzz")
st=hook("SessionStart","me",a,source="startup");quiet=hook("SessionStart","me2",b,source="startup")
present="session/me\"" in c("list","--prefix","session/").stdout
end=hook("SessionEnd","me",a,reason="exit");gone="session/me\"" not in c("list","--prefix","session/").stdout
cl=hook("PreToolUse","me3",b,tool_name="Bash",tool_input={"command":"python3 _tools/backlog.py claim ST-aaaaaaaa --by w"})
rs=hook("PreToolUse","me4",a,tool_name="Skill",tool_input={"skill":"kb-research","args":"a question"})
lines=[l for l in st[1].splitlines() if l.strip()]
reg=json.dumps(json.load(open(".claude/settings.json")).get("hooks",{}))
regd=all(e in reg for e in("SessionStart","SessionEnd","PreToolUse")) and reg.count("coord_hook.py")>=3
res=dict(start_names_overlap=st[0]==0 and "other-" in st[1] and "ST-aaaaaaaa" in st[1] and "operator" in st[1].lower(),line_budget=len(lines)<=10,
 quiet_without_overlap=quiet[0]==0 and not quiet[1].strip(),presence_lease=present,end_releases=end[0]==0 and gone,
 claim_shows=cl[0]==0 and "other-" in cl[1] and "deny" not in cl[1],research_start_shows=rs[0]==0 and "other-" in rs[1] and "deny" not in rs[1],registered=regd)
print(res);sys.exit(0 if all(res.values()) else 1)
